lines.text: This football team is broke, terrible, and run by you.
Here's how it works. Rule one. Every like on a video adds one dollar to the team fund.
Rule two. The most liked comment picks what we buy with it.
Then we build it. Day three's top comment said locker room, so we bought one. It's a garden shed.
Rule three. Want to be in the video? Comment the position you want. Quarterback, kicker, even the hot dog guy.
Every day, we pick new players from the comments. Your name goes on the roster, and you show up in the game.
On day three, seven of you joined. A quarterback, a receiver, a cornerback, and a cheerleader.
So like the video, comment your position, and follow. A new day drops every day. Maybe tomorrow, it's you.
